text: player
Mahjong, the Game You Just Can't Put Down
Yaaaaawn...
Mahjong Soul Shrine
Miki Nikaidou
You all look exhausted.
Ichihime
You're telling me, nyaa...
Kaguyahime
We've been playing mahjong literally non-stop...
And I've been stuck there with them the whole time... It's been three days, three nights...
Three days and three nights?!
Wanjirou
This is insane, woof.
Because Gin and Mr. Takasugi wanted to keep going, nyaa...
So who won in the end?
I've... lost track, nyaa...
I'd say it was about 50/50 between Gin and Takasugi. But the next thing we knew, Takasugi was just... gone.
Otherwise, they'd probably still be playing right now. The way neither of them will back down... I have to admit, it's almost impressive.
So, what about that plan of yours to destroy the Mahjong Soul Shrine and build one for yourself?
Oh, about that. That Takasugi guy did attack some ruffians who were causing trouble.//nBut regardless, I detest violence. So we parted ways, and the Kiheitai disbanded.
Naturally, my distaste for violence wasn't the only reason. While playing mahjong these past few days, I've come to realize just how incredibly delightful it is to wipe the floor with Shorty.
Don't get cocky, you bad rabbit! I won't let you get your hands on the Mahjong Soul Shrine, nyaa!
After all the twists and turns, the dust has finally settled, all thanks to you, Gin.
Gintoki Sakata
Don't mention it. It was no big deal.
Nyaa?! Gin?!
Didn't you already go back to your own world?
I was going to, but now I'm totally hooked on mahjong. Had to return for a few more rounds!//nThink I'll stick around a while longer. Hope it's not too much trouble for you guys!
By "trouble" you mean...
Where do you plan to stay?
Don't tell me...
Where do you plan to stay?
Here, of course. I'll be counting on you for my room and board!
Don't tell me you plan to freeload at the Mahjong Soul Shrine?!
Bingo! I'll be counting on you for my room and board!
But the bill has been paid, and the job is done, nyaa!
Oi oi, did you forget?//n"I'll cover all your expenses in One Han City." That was the agreement. I took on your commission, so you'd better honor the deal.
But that was only for the duration of the job, nyaa.

Oh, so that's how it is? And here I thought it was a lifetime deal.//nWell, misunderstandings happen all the time. How about we meet each other halfway and you cover my room and board for a week first? We can figure out the rest later.
Alright, but...
He's absolutely trying to freeload here forever, nyaa!
Hehehe, now that's a real tough nut to crack for you.
NOT funny at all, nyaa!
Oh, so you noticed?
Of course. I'm a deity after all!
That scoring stick holds the soul of my friend. I'm not sure why, but it seems he was summoned to this world along with me.
Nyaa...?! So that's the other helper that Master summoned...!
Turns out he was summoned as a scoring stick. That explains why he was missing all this time.
Losing it would be really bad, so I've been keeping it right here...
What happened? You're sweating bullets.
Don't tell us you lost it, woof...
What? No! Th-th-that's... absolutely not possible!
But you did, didn't you?!
You're clearly panicking, nyaa!
C'mon, don't overreact. I'll find it for sure.
That attitude shift is too sudden, nyaa!
Enough about that. Let's have a few rounds of mahjong. That's what I came back for.
Why not?
I'm joining in too, woof!
Hehehe, I shall join as well!
That's the spirit.
Follow me to the mahjong room. Right this way.
Oh right, Gin, I heard something weird happened to a... certain part of your body. You doing alright now, woof?
Ah, I had some disgusting herbal tea that {var:player_nickname}'s friend made, and it fixed me right up.//nMan, that freaked the hell out of me!
Now what...? We've got another freeloader.
Master, I have a brilliant idea, nyaa! Since things are already like this, why not just sit back and enjoy the chaos, nyaa!
Enjoy it?
Yes, and by that I mean playing mahjong, nyaa!//nWait, nyaa! Ichihime wants in too, nyaa!
Hold on, Ichihime! What sort of brilliant idea is that...?!
...But then again, this might not be so bad after all.
Ichihime & Kaguyahime
Defeating Shorty first before taking the Mahjong Soul Shrine for myself... now that will be far more interesting! You'd better be ready, Shorty!
Speaking of which, what happened to that scoring stick you pulled out? A soul from your world resides in it, no?
